decide.r: cat(tt_decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today"), "\n")

choose.r: cat(tt_choose("Which team owns this?", "please route this ticket", options = c("the refund desk", "the maybe desk", "anywhere else")), "\n")

tag.r: cat(tt_tag("Which words appear?", "the refund and the shipping", labels = c("refund", "shipping"))[[1]], "\n")

score.r: cat(tt_score("How urgent is this?", "maybe later", levels = c("Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate.")), "\n")

filter.r: cat(tt_filter("Is this a complaint?", c("good morning", "I demand a refund today")), "\n")

rank.r: cat(tt_rank("Is this a complaint?", c("good morning", "I demand a refund today"))$record, "\n")
rank.expected: I demand a refund today good morning

find.r: cat(tt_find("Which line asks for money back?", c("good morning", "I want a refund"))$unit, "\n")

files.form.json: {"version":1,"questions":{"refund":{"decide":"Does the customer ask for a refund?"},"complaint":{"decide":"Is this a complaint?","threshold":0.5}}}

annotate.r: out <- tt_annotate("form.json", data.frame(body = "I demand a refund today"), on = "body"); cat(out$refund, out$complaint, "\n")

recognize.r: found <- tt_recognize("Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.", kinds = c("person", "organization", "place"))[[1]]; cat(paste(found$text, found$kind, sep = "|"), "\n")

relate.r: edges <- tt_relate(c("Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", "Card charges are failing for every customer.", "The nightly export ran two hours late.", "The payments database ran out of disk space."), relations = "caused_by"); cat(edges$name, edges$source, edges$target, edges$probability, "\n")
